$comment: AUTHORITY for the words of the gateway's own refusals (TRANSPORT-HTTP.md § Errors): for each situation it refuses a request in itself, the status, the ErrorResponse's (or LimitRefusal's) `error`, and its `code` and `hint` where it carries them, word for word. A refusal the gateway relays from the Archivist carries the Archivist's words, not these, and a refusal of one of these situations carries no other text. A text's `{name}` is filled as the row's `situation` says. What the gateway logs of a refusal is its own: a refused token is told only that it was refused, and its log says why. `failures` is each failure frame the gateway delivers itself on the stream of the client whose request it answers, in place of an answer nobody can give. `challenges` is the `WWW-Authenticate` of each 401, in the form the Unauthorized response states; a 429 that replaces a 401 carries none.

messages.name: no-credential
messages.situation: A protected operation, asked with no credential: no `Authorization` header, a scheme that is not `Bearer`, a `Bearer` with no token, or a media token anywhere it is not accepted.
messages.hint: Authentication required: send an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. A raw browser navigation to a protected resource is unauthenticated.

messages.name: refused-token
messages.situation: A bearer token the gateway does not accept.

messages.name: refused-media-token
messages.situation: A media token `GET /api/resources/{id}` does not accept: expired, of another knowledge base, of another resource, or not one.

messages.name: refusal-rate
messages.situation: Any of the 401s above, once the refusals its holder has had have used their allowance.
messages.error: The credential was refused, and its holder's refused requests have used their allowance

messages.name: not-json
messages.situation: An operation whose body is JSON, given one that is not.

messages.name: no-idempotency-key
messages.situation: An operation that requires an `Idempotency-Key`, asked without one.

messages.name: idempotency-key-not-text
messages.situation: An `Idempotency-Key` with a character that is not visible ASCII.
messages.error: The Idempotency-Key is not text: only visible ASCII characters

messages.name: idempotency-key-length
messages.situation: An `Idempotency-Key` shorter or longer than its parameter allows: `{minLength}` and `{maxLength}` are its schema's.
messages.error: The Idempotency-Key must be {minLength} to {maxLength} characters

messages.name: unknown-channel
messages.situation: An emit on a channel the bus registry does not register: `{channel}` is the one it named.

messages.name: invalid-payload
messages.situation: An emit whose payload its channel's schema refuses: `{channel}` is the channel, and `{problems}` each refusal, as `<the member's JSON Pointer, or root>: <the refusal>`, joined by `; `.

messages.name: correlation-without-client
messages.situation: An emit that carries a `correlationId` and no `clientId`: `{channel}` is its channel.
messages.error: clientId is required to emit {channel} with a correlationId

messages.name: no-subscription
messages.situation: A subscription with no global channel and no scoped entry.
messages.error: At least one global channel or scoped entry is required

messages.name: duplicate-scope
messages.situation: A subscription whose `scoped` names one scope twice: `{scope}` is that scope.

messages.name: not-found
messages.situation: A path the gateway does not serve, or a method a path it serves does not take.

messages.name: resource-not-found
messages.situation: A resource the knowledge base does not hold: an `{id}` that is no ResourceId, one the Archivist holds no view of, or one whose bytes the Archivist answers it does not hold the resource of.

messages.name: representation-not-found
messages.situation: A resource the knowledge base holds, whose bytes the Archivist answers it does not hold.

messages.name: correlation-claimed
messages.situation: An emit whose `correlationId` another client has claimed: `{correlationId}` is it.

messages.name: too-large
messages.situation: A body larger than its operation's `maxBodyBytes`, which `{maxBodyBytes}` is.
messages.error: The body is larger than {maxBodyBytes} bytes, this operation's maxBodyBytes

messages.name: idempotency-key-reused
messages.situation: An emit sent again under its `Idempotency-Key` with another body.
messages.error: This Idempotency-Key was first sent with another body

messages.name: emit-rate
messages.situation: An emit past its principal's emit-rate bucket.
messages.error: This principal's emits have used its bucket

messages.name: unanswered-requests
messages.situation: A request on the bus past its client's unanswered requests: `{max}` is the most it may hold.
messages.error: client has {max} unanswered requests; retry when one settles

messages.name: streams
messages.situation: A subscription past the streams its principal may hold.
messages.error: This principal holds as many streams as it may

messages.name: internal
messages.situation: A fault of the gateway's own; its log says what.

messages.name: content-store-unavailable
messages.situation: A read or an upload the Archivist did not answer as its API states: it could not be reached, it did not answer in time, it refused the gateway, or it answered what its API does not; or the gateway could not get its own service token to ask it with.

messages.name: plane-unavailable
messages.situation: An emit, or anything that reads or writes a table the replicas share, while the signal plane's broker is not connected.
messages.error: The signal plane is unavailable: its broker is not connected

messages.name: capacity
messages.situation: A subscription past the queued bytes the gateway can hold.
messages.error: The gateway holds as many queued bytes as it can

failures.name: peer-unavailable
failures.situation: A request on the bus that no subscriber answers: `{channel}` is the request's channel. Its payload carries no stamp.
failures.message: No subscriber for {channel}: the service that answers it is not connected
